_comment: Settings for TMDb Helper's Trakt provider add-on (script.module.tmdbhelper.sync.trakt, TMDb Helper 6.20+). The module copied these once from TMDb Helper's old trakt_cacheownlists and nextepisodes_usecalendar keys and reads only its own copies since, so they are applied here. The Trakt token also lives in this module (setting 'token'); it is authorised on-device and never stored in this repo.
